lines.en: I scurry along the base of the wall.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上没有声音
lines.en: My paws make no sound on the floor.

lines.zh: 我从一块石头窜到另一块
lines.en: I dart from stone to stone.
My tail trails behind me.
I work along the fence looking for gaps.
I run a few steps and stop to listen.
I slip into the grass.
I poke my head out cautiously.

lines.zh: 我贴着地跑，肚子快擦到土
lines.en: I run so low my belly almost scrapes.
I go around what you dropped.
My whiskers never stop moving.
I sit with my forepaws at my chest.
I am listening inside the wall.
My whiskers twitch.

lines.zh: 我一动不动地盯着一个点
lines.en: I fix on one spot without moving.
My nose tip never stops moving.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，尾巴绕过来
lines.en: I curl up with my tail wrapped round.
There is nothing to eat here.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地把眼睛闭上又睁开
lines.en: I close my eyes, then open them.
I sit up and look around for a while.
I scratch behind my ear.
I gnaw idly at nothing.

lines.zh: 草叶晃了一下，我以为是蛇
lines.en: A blade of grass moved, and I thought it was a snake.
I am waiting for the light to fade.

lines.zh: 我在数这间屋子几个出口
lines.en: I am counting the exits in this room.
I searched everywhere and found nothing.

lines.zh: 我把头低下来，藏在草里
lines.en: I lower my head into the grass.
Something is moving by your feet.
I poke my head out of the grass.
You are so large that I must be careful.
I watch your shoes.
You mean to grab me, do you not?
I have smelled you before.
One step is all I need to escape.

lines.zh: 我是这窝里最大的一只。
lines.en: I'm the biggest of this litter.

lines.zh: 我先不动，看你要做什么
lines.en: I hold still and see what you do.

lines.zh: 你兜里那股坚果味，藏不住。
lines.en: That nutty smell in your pocket gives you away.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，但我不想被抓
lines.en: I am not afraid, I just do not want to be caught.

lines.zh: 我人立起来，胡须抖了抖。
lines.en: I stand on my hind legs and twitch my whiskers.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来就显得没那么高了
lines.en: You look less tall when you crouch.
My hind legs are already set.
I squeal with pain.
I shrink under the grass.
My leg is limping.
That spun me around.
Some of my fur is gone.
I back toward the burrow mouth.
My cry comes out high and thin.
These little legs can still run.
I have gone to ground out of sight.
That smell has me hooked.
I edge forward a little.
I eat anything, truly.
Put it down and I will come.
I can tell it is sweet.
I will bite and run.
Do not reach too fast.
That would be a meal for me.
I have followed you two steps.
My whiskers are trembling.
Your foot nearly crushed me.
I am too small for you to see.
I roll off your shoe.
Do not push, I am right by your feet.
I slip into your shadow.
I bounce half a pace away.
I am fine, just startled.

lines.zh: 别踩我尾巴，我牙尖着呢。
lines.en: Watch my tail—my teeth are sharp.
I brought her a seed.
She finds the paths better than I do.
I hear her running inside the wall.
Our nest is lined with dry grass.
I keep one exit clear.
We share one morsel.
When she moves, I wake.
Leaning together, we are not cold.
This belongs to me now.
I hold it in both forepaws.
Small enough to carry.
I carry it into the burrow.
It is bigger than my whole head.
I try to drag it.
Whoever dropped it, I am taking it.
I hide it under the dry grass.
I cannot gnaw through this at all.
I stuff it in my cheeks.

lines.zh: 你动了我藏东西的地方
lines.en: You touched my stash.
My eyes are on you.
My hind legs are cocked.
Small as I am, I bite.
Back off; I count to three.
I stand in front of the burrow.
I am not giving ground.
My teeth are very sharp.
Crouched and ready to bolt.
Move, and I move.
I circle around your feet.
I am looking for a gap to slip through.
Your hands are too high.
I am in the grass, you cannot find me.

lines.zh: 我一边退一边数你的步子
lines.en: I retreat and count your steps.
I wait for you to reach first.
This is my last reminder.
I bit you on the hand.
My teeth sink into your finger.
Tiny, but it hurts.
I bite and bolt.
I kick off you.
I land in the grass and vanish.
My incisors are sharp.

lines.zh: 你的手一下子缩回去了
lines.en: Your hand snapped away.
Do not dig at my burrow again.
I squeeze out of the wall crack.
A small shadow joins the grass.

lines.zh: 我先找了个能藏的地方
lines.en: First I found somewhere to hide.
I have never smelled this place.
I came running from the field edge.

lines.zh: 我探出头，看看有没有猫
lines.en: I poke out to check for cats.
I am living here now.
First I checked every exit.
I came along the base of the wall.
There are plenty of crumbs here.
I shake the dirt off me.
I slip into the nearest hole.

lines.zh: 火把我吓坏了，毛都焦了
lines.en: Fire terrifies me and my fur singes.
I fell off the wall.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的鼻子，我乱蹬
lines.en: Water floods my nose and I kick.
The blast throws me against the wall.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在我旁边的地上
lines.en: An arrow sticks in the ground beside me.
Magic leaves my legs weak.

lines.zh: 这里一点碎屑都找不到
lines.en: Not a single crumb to be found.

lines.zh: 雷打得很近，我钻进洞里
lines.en: Lightning strikes close and I dive into the hole.
